title: Sole-reader-scan probe surfaces every non-facade module that dereferences env.CELL or env.HUB
asA: reviewer enforcing the sole-reader guarantee on env.CELL and env.HUB
iWant: the sole-reader-scan probe to walk every .mjs/.js/.ts file under the fixture's applied source root and assert only src/do-facade.mjs dereferences env.CELL or env.HUB
soThat: a legacy call site or an accidental new one surfaces at self-review, not at runtime

acceptanceCriteria.description: The sole-reader-scan probe reads every regular file under packages/rcf-lite/test/fixtures/cf-platform/src ending in .mjs, .js or .ts, matches literal occurrences of "env.CELL" and "env.HUB" against the file path, and reports every non-facade file that contains a match as a "leak". A clean fixture has exactly one leak-free file (do-facade.mjs) that contains the matches; every other file records zero matches. Under SIMULATE_NON_FACADE_IMPORT=true the probe additionally scans a synthetic scratch file whose body dereferences env.CELL outside the facade and surfaces the leak, returning aggregateVerdict: fail.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the cf-platform fixture applied source root and, optionally, the SIMULATE_NON_FACADE_IMPORT scratch scenario
acceptanceCriteria.then: the clean-fixture pass reports zero non-facade leaks; the simulate pass surfaces the injected leak and returns fail

acceptanceCriteria.description: Comment-only mention: a JSDoc block or line comment on any non-facade module that mentions "env.CELL" or "env.HUB" (for documentation or a cross-reference) does NOT trip the scan. The probe strips block comments (/* ... */) and line comments (// ...) before matching literals; a synthetic scratch file with only a commented mention returns zero leaks.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a scratch fixture module carrying only a commented mention of env.CELL
acceptanceCriteria.when: the sole-reader-scan probe walks the fixture
acceptanceCriteria.then: the file is not reported as a leak; the leak count is zero

acceptanceCriteria.description: Nested-directory recursion: a leak in a nested path (e.g. src/handlers/deep/leak.mjs) with a real env.CELL dereference is caught by the probe. The scan walks the src/ tree recursively and reports the full relative path of every leaking file.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a synthetic src/handlers/deep/leak.mjs carrying a real env.CELL dereference
acceptanceCriteria.when: the sole-reader-scan probe walks the tree
acceptanceCriteria.then: the probe reports src/handlers/deep/leak.mjs as a leak and returns aggregateVerdict "fail"

acceptanceCriteria.description: Extension filter: the scan matches only .mjs, .js and .ts files. A .txt or .md file with a literal env.CELL substring (a README example, a config sample) is NOT scanned and does not flag; a .json fixture with an env.CELL string value is also not scanned.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a scratch tree with env.CELL literals in .txt, .md and .json files
acceptanceCriteria.when: the sole-reader-scan probe walks the tree
acceptanceCriteria.then: no leak is reported; the extension filter excludes non-source files
